gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.

gaps.lead: 'I'll finish the essay by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: 'Could you pass the salt?' said my aunt to me.
gaps.explanation: Reported request: asked me to pass.

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: I don't usually drink coffee at night.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to = (not) accustomed to: I'm not used to coffee at night.

gaps.sentence: Travel is ___ if you go off-peak.
